events.description: Phoebe Buffay asks whether Rachel Green is okay right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green needs some milk right now.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has gotten milk for Rachel Green and is giving it to Rachel Green right now.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green is being handed the milk right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green feels very stupid right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is thinking about the other day with Paolo and Phoebe Buffay.
Rachel Green says that the other day with Paolo and Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green was saying that Paolo is so great and that Paolo makes Rachel Green feel so good.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is very embarrassed right now.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is very embarrassed right now.
Phoebe Buffay says Paolo hit on Phoebe Buffay.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green met Paolo in the past.
Rachel Green says the incident of Paolo hitting on Phoebe Buffay would never have happened if Rachel Green had not met Paolo.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is very sorry right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is very sorry right now.
Phoebe Buffay tells Rachel Green to wait.
Phoebe Buffay asks what Phoebe Buffay and Rachel Green are apologizing for.
Rachel Green says Paolo is the pig.
Rachel Green says Paolo is such a pig.
Phoebe Buffay says Paolo is like a ... and trails off, searching for the word.
Rachel Green says Paolo is like a big, disgusting something.
Rachel Green says Paolo was Rachel Green's pig man.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green did not see that Paolo behaved this way, namely that Paolo hit on Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says she knows why: Paolo is gorgeous and charming, and Paolo looks at Rachel Green in a captivating way.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay told Rachel Green about Paolo hitting on Phoebe Buffay.
Rachel Green tells Phoebe Buffay to trust Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says it is much better that Rachel Green knows about Paolo hitting on Phoebe Buffay.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green liked things better before knowing about Paolo hitting on Phoebe Buffay, even though knowing is better.
